detail.note: Fix merged, waiting on the payments deploy

comments.text:
Stripe signs deliveries with the rotated endpoint secret, and payments still verifies with the old one, so every delivery answers 400.

The fix (PAY-318) is merged; it ships with the next payments deploy. Stripe keeps retrying for three days, so nothing is lost meanwhile.

comments.text:
`/var/lib/queue` on worker-02 filled because the dead-letter queue stopped draining after the consumer deploy.

- Paused the replay job and removed 3.2 GB of expired batches
- Opened OPS-1142 to cap the dead-letter queue

Free space is climbing slowly; I will look again within the hour.
